headline: Kodong Klan lands backing for its Nairobi concert
body: Sunquick is backing “All Hands-on Deck”, the Nairobi concert by Kodong Klan, according to The Standard Entertainment.
sourceHeadline: Sunquick backs Kodong Klan's 'All Hands-on Deck' Nairobi concert

headline: Racheal Magoola is bringing “Still Shining” to Kingdom Kampala
body: Kingdom Kampala will host Racheal Magoola for a concert called “Still Shining”, according to Matooke Republic. The concert marks 60th birthday and 40 years in music, the outlet reports.
sourceHeadline: Kingdom Kampala to host Racheal Magoola’s ‘Still Shining’ Concert as singer celebrates 60th birthday and 40 years in music
